_readme: Suggested reviewer models per tool, best first. Edit freely. 'notForReview' are patterns for small or speed-tuned models that are never suggested (you can still name one yourself). Which models YOUR account can use is learned as you go and kept in ~/.claude/multi-model-review/access.json, never here.

codex.why: OpenAI's flagship coding model; a strong first read from outside the Claude family
thorough, claim-by-claim checker at lower cost

copilot.why: a different model family (xAI) for an independent read
OpenAI flagship, if you have no Codex subscription
another family (Moonshot) for a third independent read
Google's family, where your Copilot plan enables it
strong, but the same family as the author, so last

claude.why: a fresh-context Claude read; same family as the author, so prefer another family first
an independent Claude read at lower cost
